capabilities: download videos from YouTube via a command
install from the plugin market or a manual release package
disambiguation: Only downloads YouTube video files; it does not embed or play videos in notes.
extras: README is minimal and partly machine-translated; points to a Chinese video walkthrough; mentions a 'Memu Downloader' without explaining it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to fetch YouTube videos as local files.
summary: Downloads videos from YouTube and saves them into the vault.
